_migration_metadata.description: Daily orders pipeline — extract → CDC → staging → production load
migration_notes: 4 sequential air_run phases mapped to 4 Databricks tasks with depends_on
PSET parameters mapped to job-level parameters + per-task base_parameters
set -e error handling mapped to task-level error routing
air sandbox run → notebook_task execution on shared job cluster
tee logging → Databricks job run logs (automatic)

name: daily_orders_pipeline
description: Daily orders ETL pipeline — migrated from Ab Initio run_daily_orders.ksh (AutoSys: JOB_DAILY_ORDERS_LOAD)

schedule._migration_note: Original AutoSys schedule — adjust cron and timezone to match production. Set pause_status to UNPAUSED when ready.

new_cluster._migration_note: Ab Initio used AI_DEFAULT_PARTITIONS=4 (setenv.ksh). Cluster sized for comparable parallelism. Adjust num_workers based on data volume.

parameters.name: source_catalog
parameters._migration_note: Unity Catalog name — replaces Ab Initio AI_SOURCE_DB=ORACLE_PROD (setenv.ksh)

parameters.name: target_catalog
parameters._migration_note: Unity Catalog name — replaces Ab Initio AI_TARGET_DB=TERADATA_DW (setenv.ksh)

parameters.name: environment
parameters._migration_note: Replaces PSET environment resolution (dev/uat/prod). Controls schema names and paths.

parameters.name: max_errors
parameters._migration_note: Maps to PSET MAX_ERRORS and setenv.ksh AI_MAX_ERRORS=100

tasks.description: Phase 1: Extract orders from source systems — replaces air sandbox run extract_orders.mp

_pset_mapping.partition_count: orders_pipeline.pset → PARTITION_COUNT (4, increased to 8 for Spark)
_pset_mapping.file_format: Inferred from Ab Initio DML delimiter metadata

tasks._migration_note: KornShell Phase 1: air sandbox run extract_orders.mp -pset orders_extract.pset -param BATCH_DATE. RC check (if [ $RC -ne 0 ]) mapped to Databricks task failure routing.

tasks.description: Phase 2: CDC detection — replaces air sandbox run cdc_orders.mp with -partition 4

_pset_mapping.source_path: Reads from extract phase output (was orders_cdc.pset source)
_pset_mapping.enable_cdf: New capability — replaces Ab Initio's hash-based CDC output files

tasks._migration_note: KornShell Phase 2: air sandbox run cdc_orders.mp -partition 4. The -partition 4 is handled by Spark's native partitioning. CDC detection via Delta MERGE replaces hash comparison.

tasks.description: Phase 3: Load to staging — replaces air sandbox run load_staging_orders.mp
tasks._migration_note: KornShell Phase 3: air sandbox run load_staging_orders.mp. LOAD_MODE=MERGE from orders_staging.pset is inherent in Delta MERGE operations. SLA_MINUTES=30 mapped to timeout_seconds=1800.

tasks.description: Phase 4: Production rollover — replaces air sandbox run prod_rollover_orders.mp
tasks._migration_note: KornShell Phase 4: air sandbox run prod_rollover_orders.mp. No retries on production writes to prevent duplicates. In Delta Lake, writes are atomic — partial failures don't leave inconsistent state.

email_notifications._migration_note: Add team email addresses. Replaces AutoSys job notifications and Ab Initio error-port alerts.

webhook_notifications._migration_note: Add Slack/PagerDuty webhook URLs. Replaces monitoring/job_monitor.py AutoSys integration.
